EduMotive Magazine is a premier trimonthly publication proudly emerging from the vibrant intellectual ecosystem of Darul Huda Islamic University. Designed as a progressive platform for creative and analytical minds, the magazine bridges the worlds of English literature, social discourse, and technological innovation.

Published every four months, EduMotive serves as a dynamic canvas for students, researchers, and thought leaders to express creative ideas and engage with contemporary issues. We believe in the power of words to drive transformation, the necessity of social awareness to heal communities, and the importance of digital literacy to navigate the future.
To inspire social transformation, cultural enlightenment, and digital literacy by empowering voices at the intersection of humanities, societal welfare, and technological evolution.

• Cultivate a deep appreciation for English literature and critical discourse.
• Provide thought-provoking commentary on contemporary social issues to drive meaningful awareness.
• Equip readers with clear insights into fast-evolving tech affairs to help them navigate the modern digital world.
